achievements.headline: Demonstrating measurable leadership across landmark international developments

items.description: International leadership experience across the Middle East, North Africa, Europe and East Asia.
Led stakeholder engagement and client relationships for landmark developments, with a combined project value exceeding $5 billion.
Led multidisciplinary teams of architects, engineers, consultants, and specialists from proposal development through construction completion.
Played key management roles in the following projects: One Za'abeel, Tadawul Tower, the Grand Extension of the Al Haram Mosque, the Camp Nou Stadium, and the E-JUST Campus.
Represented Nikken Sekkei in engagements with royal family representatives, government leaders, institutional investors, and major corporate stakeholders.

Led overseas public relations initiatives, including award submissions, corporate publications, and marketing materials. Provided comprehensive support for opening multiple overseas offices and executive client tours.

summary.headline: International project & business management across MENA, Europe and East Asia
paragraphs: I am a professional in international project and business management with over 20 years of experience delivering complex developments and strategic initiatives in the Middle East, North Africa, Europe, and East Asia.

I have extensive experience leading multinational stakeholders, managing client relationships, negotiating contracts, and coordinating large-scale projects for globally recognized developments, including the grand expansion of the the Holy Mosque in Makkah, the One Za'abeel development in Dubai, the Tadawul Tower in Riyadh, the E-Just campus in Alexandria, and the Camp Nou stadium in Barcelona.

In addition to project management, I have proven expertise in international business relations, executive-level stakeholder engagement, public relations, proposal development, and cross-cultural leadership. I have consistently represented Nikken Sekkei in interactions with government officials, royal family representatives, institutional clients, and private investors in various regions.
